questions.question: Explain two Muslim beliefs about predestination and free will.

points.text: 1) Qadr — Muslims believe Allah has decreed all things and has complete knowledge of everything that will happen. Surah 9:51 states "Nothing will happen to us except what Allah has decreed for us." 2) Free will — most Muslims also believe humans have genuine freedom to choose their actions. questions.question: "If God knows everything, humans do not have free will." Evaluate this statement.

points.text: Some argue that if Allah has complete foreknowledge, human choices are already determined. However, most Muslim scholars distinguish between God's knowledge and God's compulsion — Allah knowing what you will choose does not mean he forces you to choose it.
